description: RAFT sequence-supervision componentwise L1 objective from paper Section 3.4, Equation (7), with exponentially weighted full-resolution predictions. The official validity threshold and strict target-magnitude cutoff are in train.py:753-772; Euclidean endpoint error is a separate metric.

examples.title: Train iterative flow predictions with RAFT sequence supervision

name: RAFT sequence-supervision L1 loss

parameters.additional parameters: valid, gamma, and max_flow only; unsupported parameters raise ValueError
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because optical-flow vectors are not indexed classes
parameters.logits_or_prediction: nonempty list or tuple of floating-point flow tensors shaped [B, 2, H, W]
parameters.max_flow: finite positive real target-magnitude cutoff; vectors are retained when their L2 norm is strictly less than this value (default 400)
parameters.reduction: none returns the weighted masked component map, mean averages all B*2*H*W components including masked zeros, or sum totals all components (default mean)
parameters.targets: floating-point ground-truth flow tensor shaped [B, 2, H, W], matching prediction dtype and device
parameters.valid: required tensor shaped [B, H, W]; values greater than or equal to 0.5 are marked valid
